dedupe_keys.name: get information about schools gias england

description: Get Information about Schools is the Department for Education's register of educational establishments in England, run as a GOV.UK service (still marked beta). Users can search establishments, establishment groups such as academy trusts, and governance roles in state-maintained establishments and trusts, and can download files of the publicly available data fields, which are updated daily. Establishments and local authorities update their own records through DfE Sign-in. Coverage: schools and other establishments in England. Access: web search and download files on the service. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): OGL-UK-3.0 (GIAS site: all content under OGL v3.0 except where otherwise stated). Access is free of charge. Caveats: the register describes establishments, not buildings, so building condition and footprints need other sources such as the DfE condition data collection. Simulation uses are locating schools for flood and heat exposure, planning school use as rest centres and linking establishments to building data. Related records: the DfE Condition Data Collection programme.
